brief:
A leaked Palestinian Authority finance ministry report accuses Al-Huda Group, a West Bank petrol station chain owned by Tarek al-Natsheh, of tax evasion and financial misconduct, Middle East Eye reported. The claim totals $325 million and stems from an ongoing fuel-smuggling investigation.

The document details alleged irregularities in fuel distribution and taxation practices by the company, which operates multiple service stations across the West Bank.
dek: Revealed: West Bank petrol station chain faces $325m claim in PA fuel-smuggling probe Submitted by Simon Hooper on Wed, 11/11/2026 - 12:12 Leaked finance ministry report accuses Tarek al-Natsheh’s Al-Huda Group of tax evasion and financial misconduct.
title: Palestinian Authority sues fuel distributor for $325 million in smuggling probe
